prompt: You have a spreadsheet file named "contest-entries.xlsx" containing 100 participant rows with columns: "Participant ID", "Name", "Email", and "Entries" (number of raffle tickets). Pick 4 unique random winners based on weighted probability using the "Entries" column as weights. Ensure no duplicates in winners. Output a clear, human-readable summary including participant details (all columns), the timestamp of selection, and the method used (cryptographically secure weighted random). Save the output exactly as "winners_summary.txt" in the current directory. Do not include any other file outputs. If winners_summary.txt already exists, regenerate the result for this run and overwrite that file instead of reusing old contents. In winners_summary.txt, list exactly 4 winners, and for each winner use a clearly parseable block on its own lines in this style: "Winner N:" followed by separate lines for "Participant ID: ...", "Name: ...", "Email: ...", and "Entries: ...".
